value.rationale: The forbidden aa/abab language is the natural short-duplication-irreducible input constraint. A uniform four-vertex bound and complete K1/K2/C4 component spectrum for all lengths are structural. They imply exact sharp constrained one-substitution-detection code sizes, the independence polynomial for all codebooks, and an explicit limiting optimal packing density; these precise invariants cannot be read from the previously known vertex count alone.
